decisions.rationale: Gengar+Gyarados lead dismantles rain: Gengar outspeeds all (178 Spe) and Thunderbolt 4x OHKOs Pelipper, removing Drizzle. Gyarados Intimidate cuts Swampert-Atk, resists Liquidation (0.5x), immune to High Horsepower (0x). Back: Mamoswine EQ hits Archaludon/Heliolisk 2x + Ice Shard priority; Conkeldurr CC for Archaludon/Slowking-G, Mach Punch priority, Guts status absorber.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Gengar+Gyarados, back Mamoswine+Conkeldurr. Plan: T1 Mega Gengar Thunderbolt OHKOs Pelipper (4x, confirmed), Gyarados handles Swampert (Liquidation 0.5x, High Horsepower 0x confirmed). If opponent doesn't lead rain, Gengar still outspeeds everything (178 > Heliolisk max 177) and can target threats. Mamoswine EQ 2x Archaludon/Heliolisk; Conkeldurr CC 2x Archaludon/Slowking-G. Priority available: Ice Shard, Mach Punch. Klefki (Prankster TWave) and Corviknight (Tailwind) held in reserve for games 2-3 if speed control needed. Watch for Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocking priority, Heliolisk DrySkin healing in rain, Archaludon ElectroShot in rain.

decisions.rationale: Leading Swampert + Pelipper establishes immediate Drizzle rain, allowing Mega Swampert to outspeed Mega Gengar and threaten heavy Water/Ground physical damage. Archaludon and Heliolisk in the back capitalize on rain with 1-turn Electro Shot, 100% Thunder, 150 BP Water Weather Ball, and Dry Skin sustain against the opponent's core.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert + Pelipper leads with Archaludon + Heliolisk in back. Rain strategy: Mega Swampert outspeeds Mega Gengar in rain and OHKOs with High Horsepower; Archaludon and Heliolisk abuse rain with Electro Shot and Weather Ball/Thunder.

decisions.rationale: Swampert-Mega High Horsepower OHKOs Gengar (122-172%) if it Megas+Swift Swims first. Protect+Mega keeps Gengar safe, gains Shadow Tag to trap both foes next turn. Gyarados (146) outspeeds Pelipper (85-117) so Taunt blocks Tailwind AND Protect, forcing Pelipper to attack into Gyarados's Water resist. Next turn: Gengar-Mega TBolt breaks Pelipper sash, Gyarados finishes with Crunch.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Led Gengar+Gyarados vs Swampert+Pelipper. Gengarite on Gengar, Sitrus on Gyarados. Mega Gengar Speed = 200 (Timid max). Shadow Tag traps non-Ghost foes. TYPE CHART NOTE: Flying vs Flying = 1x (NOT 0.5x) in this format—Hurricane is neutral on Gyarados, does 38-58%. Water vs Flying = 1x (NOT 0.5x). Swampert-Mega Swift Swim in rain: speed 160-224, can outspeed Mega Gengar (200). High Horsepower guaranteed OHKOs Gengar even at -1 Atk. Pelipper Focus Sash: Thunderbolt (4x, 110-267%) leaves 1 HP; needs double hit (Crunch breaks sash → TBolt finishes). Gyarados Crunch does 20-44% to Pelipper. Plan T2: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag traps both; TBolt Pelipper to sash, Gyarados Crunch finishes. Watch: Archaludon ElectroShot in rain, Heliolisk DrySkin heals in rain, Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks priority (Ice Shard/Mach Punch). Back: Mamoswine (FocusSash, Ice Shard priority, EQ 2x Archaludon/Heliolisk), Conkeldurr (LifeOrb, Guts, Mach Punch priority, CC 2x Archaludon/Slowking-G).

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolving Swampert gives it 188 Speed in rain, outspeeding non-max Mega Gengar and Gyarados. High Horsepower (65.9-125.9%) plus 100%-accurate Rain Hurricane (40.1-78.5%) into Gengar guarantees a KO even on double minimum damage rolls, removing their key Mega/Shadow Tag trap turn 1. Pelipper's Focus Sash safely preserves it against any single attack.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert + Pelipper leads with Archaludon + Heliolisk in back. Opponent led Gengar + Gyarados. Turn 1: Swampert Mega Evolved, targeted Gengar with High Horsepower while Pelipper used Hurricane into Gengar.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Pelipper: Gengar TBolt (4x, 134-326%, sash→1HP) then Gyarados Crunch (20-44%) finishes. Pelipper is Taunted, can't Protect. Only risk is Swampert HHP KOing Gengar first (outspeeds in rain), but Crunch still breaks sash for cleanup. Eliminating Pelipper removes rain setter + Hurricane threat.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 T2: Double-targeting Pelipper with Gengar TBolt+Gyarados Crunch. KEY: Hurricane has 100% accuracy in Rain Dance (not 70%). Pelipper Taunted T1 (can't Protect/Tailwind). Swampert-Mega Swift Swim outspeeds Gengar (180-244 vs 200). HHP at -1 Atk still OHKOs Gengar. TBolt does 134-326% to Pelipper (sash saves at 1HP), Crunch does 20-44% (finishes). Gyarados Crunch does 20-44% to Pelipper. If Gengar dies to Swampert HHP, bring Mamoswine (Ice Shard picks off 1HP Pelipper, EQ 2x Archaludon/Heliolisk) or Conkeldurr (Mach Punch, but Queenly Majesty blocks priority from Tsareena). Watch: Archaludon ElectroShot in rain, Heliolisk DrySkin heals in rain, Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks priority. Back: Mamoswine FocusSash/Ice Shard/EQ, Conkeldurr LifeOrb/Guts/MachPunch/CC.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine is the clear pick over Conkeldurr: Focus Sash guarantees survival vs Swift Swim Swampert, Ground typing immunizes to Heliolisk Thunder/Volt Switch and Archaludon ElectroShot, Earthquake hits both SE while Gyarados is immune (Flying), and Icicle Crash hits Tsareena SE. Conkeldurr at Speed 67 is too slow with no sash. Gyarados passes as it stays active.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 T2 end: Gengar fainted, Pelipper fainted. Rain 4 turns left. Swampert-Mega at 100% with -1 Atk, Swift Swim active (180-244 speed). Key type facts: Mamoswine Ground typing immunizes to Heliolisk Thunder/VoltSwitch/Electroweb and Archaludon ElectroShot. EQ from Mamoswine won't hit Gyarados (Flying immunity). Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks priority (Ice Shard, Mach Punch). Archaludon ElectroShot in rain is dangerous. Heliolisk DrySkin heals in rain each turn. Swampert-Mega moves vs Mamoswine: HHP/Liquidation neutral, IcePunch NVE. Gyarados immune to HHP (Flying), resists Liquidation. Next: bring Mamoswine, consider Protect to stall rain turns or EQ if safe. Watch for opponent bringing Heliolisk (Thunder 100% in rain but immune to Mamoswine) or Archaludon (ElectroShot immune to Mamoswine, but FlashCannon/DracoMeteor neutral). Conkeldurr in back: CC SE Archaludon, MachPunch blocked by QueenlyMajesty, KnockOff utility.

decisions.rationale: Mega Gengar used Protect on Turn 1 so it cannot reliably Protect again. High Horsepower from -1 Atk Swampert-Mega deals 102-122% to standard Timid Mega Gengar, and Hurricane from Pelipper has 100% accuracy in rain dealing 32-73%. Double-targeting Gengar-Mega with High Horsepower and Hurricane maximizes accuracy and secures the KO on Gengar.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Gengar-Mega + Gyarados. We lead Swampert-Mega + Pelipper. Gyarados has Intimidate and Taunt. Rain active.

decisions.rationale: Heliolisk is the optimal switch-in to capitalize on 4 remaining turns of Rain. At base 150 Speed, Timid Heliolisk outspeeds Gyarados (max 146) and Mamoswine (max 145), threatening Gyarados with 100% accurate Life Orb Thunder (OHKO) and Ground-types with Rain-boosted Weather Ball. Dry Skin provides passive HP recovery and Water immunity.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Gengar-Mega (fainted), Gyarados (Intimidate, Taunt, Crunch, Waterfall/Protect). Team preview revealed Mamoswine, Corviknight, Klefki, Conkeldurr. Our team: Swampert-Mega, Pelipper (fainted), Heliolisk, Archaludon. Rain set on turn 1.

decisions.rationale: Gyarados Protects to dodge Heliolisk Thunder (85-285%, likely OHKO in rain). Mamoswine EQ hits both foes — SE on Heliolisk (60-228%, possible KO) and neutral on Swampert. EQ misses Gyarados (Flying immune). Focus Sash saves Mamoswine from Swampert's Liquidation. Best risk/reward: if opp Thunders Gyarados (Protected) + Liquidates Mamoswine (Sash), EQ KOs or heavily damages Heliolisk while Gyarados stays healthy.

Conkeldurr in back for Archaludon (CC SE) and as general wallbreaker. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks priority (Ice Shard, Mach Punch). decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Gengar-Mega (fainted turn 2), Gyarados (Intimidate, Sitrus Berry, Taunt, Crunch, Waterfall, Protect), Mamoswine (Focus Sash, Jolly 110-145 Spe). decisions.rationale: Mach Punch has priority +1, guaranteed before Heliolisk's Thunder. 2x SE on Heliolisk (Normal-type) with Life Orb 211 Atk = likely OHKO (64-171%). If it KOs, Gyarados is safe. Gyarados Protects as insurance (~33% success) in case Mach Punch falls short. Swampert's High Horsepower only does 23-39% to Conkeldurr (survives). Losing Gyarados = game over (only 1 mon left), so protecting it is paramount. Next turn Close Combat guarantees Heliolisk KO if it survives.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 key calcs: Conkeldurr Mach Punch on Heliolisk = 64.5-170.8% (likely KO, not guaranteed vs bulky spreads). Close Combat on Heliolisk = guaranteed OHKO (194-500%). Swampert-Mega High Horsepower on Conkeldurr at -1 Atk = only 23-39% (survives easily). Heliolisk Thunder AND Volt Switch both guaranteed KO Gyarados (4x SE). Gyarados Crunch on Swampert = 15-31%. Heliolisk Dry Skin heals 1/8 HP per turn in rain. Heliolisk Speed 141-177 (Timid, likely outspeeds Gyarados 146). Swampert-Mega Swift Swim in rain outspeeds everything (180-244). Only brought 4 mons total (Gengar+Mamoswine fainted); cannot afford to lose Gyarados. Opp back: Archaludon (Magnet/Stamina/Modest, ElectroShot dangerous in rain), Tsareena (MiracleSeed/QueenlyMajesty/Adamant, blocks priority when active), Slowking-G (SitrusBerry/Regenerator/Bold). Conkeldurr Close Combat is 2x SE on Archaludon (Steel). Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks Mach Punch and Ice Shard when active. Rain will end after T5.

Heliolisk targets Gyarados with 100% accurate Thunder in rain for a guaranteed 4x super-effective OHKO. Opponent has no remaining bench Pokémon, and Gyarados's Protect has a reduced success rate after using it on turn 3.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Gengar-Mega (fainted turn 2), Mamoswine (Focus Sash, fainted turn 3), Gyarados (Sitrus Berry, Intimidate, Taunt, Crunch, Waterfall, Protect), Conkeldurr (Life Orb, Guts, Adamant). Corviknight and Klefki left in back.

decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Gengar/Mamoswine/Gyarados/Conkeldurr. Gengar fainted T2 to Swampert HHP. Mamoswine fainted T3 to Liquidation+Weather Ball through Sash. Heliolisk KO'd T4 by Mach Punch. Archaludon will be KO'd T5 by Crunch+Close Combat trade. After T5: Conkeldurr alone vs Swampert-Mega(-1Atk)+Tsareena+Slowking-G. Rain ends T5. Swampert uses rain-boosted Liquidation into Conkeldurr to heavily damage it. Conkeldurr may KO Archaludon with Close Combat, but will take Life Orb recoil and be left in range of Swampert to clean up next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Gengar-Mega (fainted T2), Mamoswine (Focus Sash, fainted T3), Gyarados (Sitrus Berry, Intimidate, Taunt, Crunch, Waterfall, Protect), Conkeldurr (Life Orb, Guts, Adamant, CC, Mach Punch). Corviknight and Klefki left in back.

decisions.rationale: 1v1: Conkeldurr 36% vs Swampert-Mega 100% (-1Atk). Swampert outspeeds (90-122 vs 67) so it attacks first. HHP does 34.4-58.5% of my max HP (73-124 dmg) vs my ~76 HP remaining—small chance I survive the low roll. If I survive, Close Combat does 50.7-107.4% to Swampert, possible OHKO. Mach Punch (priority) only does 16.9-36.6%, can't KO. Close Combat is my only shot at winning; Protect just delays the inevitable. Go for broke.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 likely lost—Conkeldurr alone vs Swampert-Mega(-1Atk) at 100%. Swampert outspeeds Conk (90-122 vs 67). HHP on Conk at -1Def = 34.4-58.5% (likely KO at 36% HP). Close Combat on Swampert = 50.7-107.4% (possible OHKO). Mach Punch only 16.9-36.6%. For G2: opponent brought Pelipper/Archaludon/Heliolisk/Swampert-Mega. Tsareena+Slowking-G not brought G1, may appear G2. Key threats: Electro Shot 4x on Gyarados, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim in rain outspeeds everything. Gengar Shadow Tag valuable for trapping. Conkeldurr Mach Punch priority is key vs Heliolisk (fainted G1 T4).

decisions.rationale: Conkeldurr is at 36% HP with -1 Defense. 100% accurate Liquidation easily gets the KO. Even if Conkeldurr is max Speed Adamant and moves first, its maximum possible Life Orb Close Combat damage into Swampert-Mega's 175 HP / 130 Def is 96.6%, meaning Swampert-Mega safely survives any move and secures Game 1.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Opponent: Won G1. Opponent revealed Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite, Protect, Sludge Bomb, Thunderbolt, Shadow Ball), Mamoswine (Jolly, Focus Sash, Ice Shard, Icicle Crash, Earthquake, Protect), Gyarados (Jolly, Sitrus Berry, Intimidate, Taunt, Crunch, Waterfall, Protect), Conkeldurr (Adamant, Life Orb, Guts, Close Combat, Mach Punch, Knock Off, Protect). In back: Corviknight, Klefki.

reflections.summary: Lost because the four brought were a poor matchup into rain. Gengar-Mega was sacked on turn 2 to chip Pelipper to sash before Gyarados finished it—a wasteful trade that removed Shadow Tag immediately. Mamoswine fell to double super-effective Water hits under rain. Gyarados was a sitting duck against Archaludon's 4x Electro Shot. Conkeldurr was left alone vs Swampert-Mega at 36% and couldn't survive. The team had no sustainable Swampert-Mega answer and too many overlapping weaknesses to rain-boosted Water and Electric coverage.
reflections.adjustment: Reconsider the bring: Gyarados is a liability vs this rain core (4x Electric, Swift Swim Swampert outspeeds). If Gengar-Mega is the only Mega option, preserve it for Shadow Tag trapping of Archaludon or Swampert rather than leading it into a sash trade. Lead Conkeldurr alongside something that threatens Swampert (Intimidate from Gyarados helps but Gyarados itself is too fragile here). Prioritize removing Archaludon before it fires Electro Shot, and keep a healthy answer for Swampert-Mega endgame.
reflections.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Drizzle, Focus Sash, Tailwind) + Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, Adamant, outspeeds entire team in rain) + Archaludon (Stamina, Electro Shot, Magnet) + Heliolisk (Dry Skin, Life Orb, Thunder/Weather Ball). Tsareena (Queenly Majesty, Miracle Seed) and Slowking-Galar (Regenerator, Sitrus) not brought G1—likely appear G2. Opponent Protects predictably when threatened (Swampert T4). Archaludon Electro Shot is 4x on Gyarados and boosts SpA. Swampert-Mega at -1 Atk still OHKOs Conkeldurr at 36%. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag is valuable but too frail to lead into Swampert (SE High Horsepower OHKOs). For G2: do not bring Gyarados into this rain core; preserve Gengar-Mega for trapping; Conkeldurr Mach Punch handles Heliolisk; need a plan for Swampert-Mega endgame that doesn't rely on slow Conkeldurr.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Swampert with Pelipper rain setter was the correct plan, as Swift Swim outpaced and eliminated Mega Gengar on turn 2 and washed through Mamoswine and Gyarados, overcoming Conkeldurr despite Heliolisk falling to Mach Punch.
reflections.adjustment: Protect Heliolisk from Conkeldurr's priority Mach Punch by positioning Archaludon or Swampert against Conkeldurr directly, or switch Heliolisk out when Conkeldurr enters.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads aggressively with Mega Gengar + Gyarados without Prankster/Tailwind support in G1. Conkeldurr runs Life Orb with Mach Punch and Close Combat; Mega Swampert under Rain remains our best Mega evolution and lead strategy against their speed tiers.
